sloka: लङ्का चारयितव्या वै पुनरेव भवेदिति ।रात्रौ न हि सुदृष्टा मे दुर्गकर्मविधानतः ।। 5.53.14।।।।
transliteration: laṅkā cārayitavyā vai punareva bhavediti ।rātrau na hi sudṛṣṭā me durgakarmavidhānataḥ ।। 5.53.14।।।।

translations.english: 'I am strong enough to destroy all the demons in a battle. I am enduring this humiliation in order to make Rama happy. In this way I will get a chance to see Lanka once again.
